messages:
Marta: quick heads-up — smoke bringup of the new reranker rb3-small-v2 (ONNX export) shows a noticeable NDCG drop vs baseline on our goldenset. can we do a quick triage?
Kevin: what's the exact artifact + eval command you ran? ONNX fp16 or dynamic quant?
Marta: exported with export_v2.py --use-onnx --quantize=dynamic then converted to fp16. Eval command: `./eval_runner --model artifacts/rb3-small-v2.onnx --dataset goldenset-v3 --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --batch 64 --seqlen 256 --pad right`
Sriram: watch out — batching/seqlen/pad differences can change prefix behavior. Are we using identical preprocessing as prod?
Marta: good catch — eval was right-pad; prod serving uses left-pad for the priming prompt. also we strip HTML in eval but prod pipeline doesn't.
Olivia: that formatting/normalization mismatch alone could explain systematic shift. normalize pipeline first (either strip in prod or keep raw in eval) and re-run.
Kevin: also check ORT kernel fallbacks with fp16 — sometimes attention falls back to CPU and causes numeric differences. what ORT version? opset?
Marta: ORT 1.14, opset 13. Reran float32 as TorchScript — float32 matches baseline; fp16 ONNX drops ~1.8% NDCG@10 and MRR@10 by ~0.6. bootstrap CI looks non-trivial.
Sriram: what's the sample size and CI? small N can make noise look real.
Marta: goldenset ~1.2k queries. bootstrap 95% CI for ndcg diff = [-2.6, -0.9] so seems significant. but sample bias possible (goldenset curation).
Olivia: suggested plan: 1) re-run eval with prod preprocessing (left-pad, no-html-strip) 2) run ORT CPU vs GPU kernels to isolate kernel fallback 3) try PTQ int8 on a small slice as an ablation 4) collect top-k example diffs and human inspect.
Kevin: also add a release smoke checklist into the PR: include eval command, sample diffs (3 failing/3 baseline), export flags, ONNX opset, ORT version, batching config, seqlen/pad, tokenizer snapshot. I'll make a GH template.
Marta: uploading artifacts + sample diffs to s3://redwood-ml/tmp/rb3-small-v2/, will paste link here when done.
eval-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ml/tmp/rb3-small-v2/rb3-small-v2.onnx
Sriram: double-check tokenizer/token counts — a small token shift (avg tokens 23.1 vs 23.9) can amplify reranker score differences, esp with priming tokens.
Marta: noted — I'll attach tokenization stats and a handful of ranked lists for the worst regressions.
Olivia: :thumbsup: if fp16 still degrades after alignment, we can either keep float32 export or selectively force float32 kernels for matmuls, or try a calibration run for dynamic quant thresholds.
Kevin: also gate canary: block full rollout if ndcg drop >1% on shadow traffic, auto-rollback.
Marta: thanks all — updating thread with re-run results in ~30m.
